requirements.description: Lucky Grid hides three prizes on random distinct cells of a nine-cell board on the shared exactly-once settlement core, then settles the player's three picks by how many land on a prize. A reveal debits one bounded play-token stake. Matching all three prizes pays a twenty-five-times jackpot, matching two pays three times, and matching one or none pays nothing. Over the eighty-four equally likely prize placements a fixed set of picks matches all three once, two eighteen times, one forty-five times, and none twenty times, so the paytable returns 0.9405 on average for a house edge of about six percent. Pick sets that are not three distinct in-range cells and non-integer, non-positive, or over-limit stakes are rejected before any wallet movement.
requirements.notes: Allocated for GitHub issue #153, a catalog-expansion game (#73). The module supplies only pure rules; the shared core owns settlement.

requirements.description: Lucky Grid inherits the shared core's exactly-once settlement: one caller-stable request id maps to one reveal, a retry replays the identical committed prizes and payout without moving the wallet again, and a request id reused with different wager content fails closed. The additive v1 contract exposes only the game-owned state and reveals routes and never alters the frozen shared API. Every reveal commits three distinct prize cells, and the published bet catalog reports the honest board size, pick count, and match multipliers.
